csv_project_name: Shoreline Resilience Feasibility for a Fairfield Beach
csv_scope_of_work: The University of Connecticut is accepting sealed Proposals for: Shoreline Resilience Feasibility and Concept Design for a Fairfield Beach. The purpose of this Request for Proposal (RFP) is to request Cost Proposals and Statements of Qualifications from qualified Companies to provide planning services for sustainability and resilience-focused projects (hereafter referred to as the Services ) to support a Candidate (hereafter referred to as the Awardee ) of the Long Island Sound (LIS) Resilience Planning Support Program.

title: Shoreline Resilience Feasibility and Concept Design for a Fairfield Beach
short_description: Feasibility and concept design for a shoreline resilience project at Fairfield Beach.
project_scope: Feasibility study and concept design for a shoreline resilience project at Fairfield Beach under the Long Island Sound Resilience Planning Support Program. The tender seeks sustainability- and resilience-focused planning support. No technical dimensions, spans, areas, or structural quantities are stated.
services: Planning services including architecture, civil engineering, cost estimating, feasibility studies, master planning, and environmental engineering/planning/design.
relevance_explanation:
- Early-stage feasibility and concept design only; no defined structural design scope.
- Focus is shoreline resilience planning rather than bridges, buildings, roofs, or special load-bearing structures.
- Includes civil engineering, but mainly as part of planning, environmental, and resilience studies.
- Falls close to environmental/feasibility planning, which is generally low priority for sbp.
- No evidence of complex structural systems, long spans, or architecturally demanding structures.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the source. The notice is for feasibility and concept design services only, with no defined built scope, dimensions, or quantities, so a realistic construction cost estimate is not possible.
fee_explanation: No fee or budget for planning services is stated in the source. As the procurement is for feasibility and concept design support without a stated construction budget or fee schedule, a realistic sbp fee estimate is not possible.
references_qualifications: Qualified companies are requested to submit cost proposals and statements of qualifications for planning services related to sustainability and resilience-focused projects. No specific minimum reference counts or detailed qualification thresholds are stated in the source.
contracting_authority: University of Connecticut Capital Projects, Agency ID 19352. Contact: Cesar Alonzo, Phone: 860-486-0012, Fax: 860-486-1953, Email: cesar.alonzo@uconn.edu, Website: https://portal.ct.gov/das/ctsource/bidboard?language=en_US
notes: Project number: CA050126. Funding: US EPA. Pre-submittal meeting: 05/15/2026 10:00 AM EDT via Microsoft Teams; attendance recommended. Questions deadline: 05/29/2026 02:00 PM EDT. The source labels the target market as General Building, but the actual scope is shoreline resilience feasibility and concept design rather than a conventional building project. Category assigned as Special structures due to lack of a better fit within the fixed list.
